firstText: Today we are preparing the boat for a short trip along the coast. The weather report says the wind will stay gentle until the evening. Please put the blue notebook beside the chart table and check that the cabin lights are working. We will bring fresh water, bread, fruit, warm jackets, a small repair kit, and enough rope for the next harbour. Before we leave, walk around the deck and close every open hatch.
secondText: Now I am speaking again while the earlier passage is being corrected.
